concept: CloudFront: edge caching and compression to cut data transfer out
tests: Which two changes cut data transfer cost and latency for repeated requests to the origin.
expected: CloudFront caches content at the edge (less origin load and data transfer out) + compresses text responses at the edge (fewer bytes). Triggers: "reduce data transfer costs", "repeated requests to origin", "global users", (Choose two).
why_not: Serving everything from EC2 in one Region raises cost and latency; a bigger instance doesn't cut transfer cost.
